summary: Frontend-only test of kiosk Betalingsgeschiedenis row layout. Logged in via PIN 4321 (Anita) on /my-awesome-rentals-bv/login?view=pin -> Hoofdvestiging -> apt HUIS 1B (2 payments) -> overview-history-btn. Mobile 390x844: both history-row-{id} are display:flex, flex-direction:row, align-items:center; info column right edge 264px vs button group left edge 276px (12px gap, no overlap); info vertical centre == button-group centre (366/366, 478/478); no text truncation, no horizontal overflow; period text wraps onto 2 lines cleanly. history-whatsapp-{id} and history-print-{id} are 36x36, border-radius 9999px, icon-only (innerText empty), side by side on the same top (WA right 312, Print left 318). Desktop 1920: buttons 96x32 / 91x32 with radius 8px, labels 'WhatsApp' and 'Afdruk' visible, chevron visible, still vertically centred, one-line info. Afdruk dropdown history-print-menu-{id} opens on mobile (only the 'Afdrukken' local option because no KT-V520/BT printer online) and closes via backdrop. WhatsApp button clickable (shows pressed state; handler fetches image/opens share or wa.me).
critical_code_review_comments: KioskLayout.jsx is ~5000 lines - should be split (PaymentHistoryModal could be its own file).
Tested payments had no received_by/approved_by values, so the 'Ontvangen door / Goedgekeurd door' line was not visually checked; with min-w-0 + break-words on the info column it should wrap fine.
The Print button was visible (not hidden). No printers were online, so the dropdown only showed 'Afdrukken'.
